text:
Ana: Quick sync — running joint webinar with CloudOcean + VoltEdge on Sept 24 (APAC-friendly 9am PT slot). Tentative agenda: 1) 20m product demo 2) 20m partner tech deep dive 3) 15m live lab + Q&A 4) giveaway + outro. Need confirmations: speakers, demo hosts, swag lead, booth link.

Mike: I can host the live lab demo, prefer to demo Dedicated autoscale example. Need an SMTP/static IP for webhook tests. @ops-bot can you open a short env?

ops-bot: Created ephemeral env 'webinar-staging-09-24' with public endpoint, creds in 1Password.

Sarah: I'll do the product demo. Can we shorten slides to 12 mins? Also recommend capturing a 5-min recorded fallback video.

Jordan: VoltEdge speaker confirmed (Priya). CloudOcean speaker TBD — they asked for PR-friendly slide deck by Aug 30. I'll follow up.

Lee: Swag logistics: budget ok for 200 sticker packs + 100 tees. Need sizes by Sept 1. Shipping ETA 7-10 business days from vendor. Recommend promo code printed on back.

Ana: Great. Action items: 1) Mike to prep lab runbook and fallback video by Sept 10. 2) Sarah slide deck v1 by Aug 30. 3) Jordan to lock CloudOcean speaker by Aug 20. 4) Lee send size form to partners @cloudops-team. 5) Ops-bot keep env up for smoke tests Aug 25-Sept 26.

Mike: Labs runbook draft in this thread: ```Runbook: 1) Start dedicated pool -> deploy demo image 2) Warm KV cache (prefix script) 3) Start loadgen -> monitor latency 4) Fallback: switch to quantized model variant``` Will push to repo.

Sarah: +1 on recorded fallback. Also asking legal for co-branding logo ok, they'll confirm by Aug 22.

Jordan: I'll ping CloudOcean EPD and DM them the slide template.

Lee: Swag form link: https://forms.gle/xxxx — partners fill by Sept 1. Also prefer we ship US distribution to partners' APAC regional rep to avoid customs.

Ana: Thanks team. Can we have a dry run Sept 17 11am PT? Any blockers?

Mike: Dry run ok, need test data from product (small corpus) — @sarah can you share?

Sarah: Sent sample corpus to #ci-artifacts, link: https://artifacts.internal/repo/xyz

Jordan: Noted. Will confirm CloudOcean by Aug 20 and update here.

Lee: Will finalize vendor and ETA by Aug 28.

Ana: Filing this as final action list. I'll update calendar invite once CloudOcean confirmed. :thumbsup:
